title: Hollywood Food Tour with To Live and Dine in LA Food Tours
includes: Insights into Hollywood’s music, literary, and film history
Varied architecture and famous movie theaters
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller

cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Book direct to save and support our small business in the process! Visit our website - To Live and Dine in LA Food Tours

Hollywood can feel like a maze of tourist traps and mediocre food—so let us take the guesswork out of your visit! Experience one of LA’s most iconic neighborhoods, find hidden gems in unlikely settings, and discover that Hollywood is more than just the stars on the Walk of Fame.

We’ll eat diverse cuisine at 5 different restaurants ranging from a Michelin-rated spot, to a 30+ year-old establishment, to a beloved celebrity-owned joint. 

Dive into impressive music/literary/film history, appreciate gorgeous architecture, and marvel at historic theaters.

This 3-hour tour is great for locals/visitors and is perfect for a birthday celebration, bachelor(ette) party, or team building event for coworkers.

Please note drinks are not included, nor is tour guide gratuity (15-20% recommended). Not suitable for vegans/gluten-free guests; please take our LA Taco Tour instead.
